name: True Polymorph — the permanent that becomes the copy is a target artifact or creature
notes: Found by tests/audit.py once copy units were audited (2026-11-17). "Target artifact or creature becomes a copy of …": the copy effect had no restriction, so its picker listed every permanent, lands and enchantments included. The subject of a plain "becomes a copy of" is now read as the target (cards-parser.js, copy section).
